segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: NVIDIA's robot AI learns from people

beats.narration: We learn many skills just by watching others. So can a robot learn from videos of people at work?
NVIDIA trained a new robot AI on a huge collection of those videos.
It pictures what should happen next, and plans the robot's moves at the same time.
Then NVIDIA gave it tasks this robot had never done before.
Shown each one just a handful of times, it succeeded ninety-five percent of the time.

items.label: success after a few demonstrations · NVIDIA

beats.narration: NVIDIA says these skills carry over between robots, so each needs less teaching from scratch.

visual.sub: skills carry across robot bodies · NVIDIA on X
